Figure 1:(a) Three representative Training-Distribution Hallucination cases from video-generative WAMs under LIBERO-Plus background-texture, illumination, and camera-viewpoint shifts.

DINOv3 and Wan-VAE cosine similarities across same-state frames.

Figure 2:Overview of ST-WAM.
(a): Dual-Space Future Experts (DSFE) jointly model future dynamics in the VAE visual-latent space and the DINOv3 semantic space.
The visual and semantic future experts interact with the action expert through a three-branch Mixture-of-Transformers.
(b): Current-Anchored Intent Retrieval (CAIR).
Figure 3:Structured cross-branch attention masks during training and inference.
Figure 4:Real-world evaluation of ST-WAM on five tasks with diverse temporal and geometric requirements.

Figure 5:Attention heatmaps on two representative tasks.
Warmer colors indicate stronger relative attention within each map.
